registered_before: any distance to buildings or roads was computed or viewed for any sample
status: exploratory grouped cross-validation on already seen events (V0.5 cohort); no new independent test
question: How much of the V0.5 separation between the reported slope and ten unmatched surrounding slopes can be reproduced by the visibility of a slope alone (distance to the nearest building or road), and how much of the terrain / land-cover skill remains when controls are equally close to infrastructure as the reported slope?
primary_endpoint: (b) conditional-logit static local AUC (unit-weighted, V0.5 out-of-fold repetition-wise median) on the caliper-restricted groups compared with the same model on all groups (paired on the same groups; 95 % interval from the unit bootstrap of repetition 1)
decision_rule: The terrain / land-cover skill is called infrastructure-independent only if the restricted-group AUC stays above chance with an interval excluding 0.5 AND the drop relative to all groups has an interval including zero; otherwise it is reported as (partly) explained by infrastructure visibility. Nothing here is a causal statement.
must_not_change: V0.5 dataset, freeze, CV plan, oof predictions and results

source.licence: ODbL 1.0, attribution '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors'; local non-commercial research use only
source.temporal_caveat: snapshot of 2026-10-14; events date from 2016 onwards. Buildings and public roads are largely persistent but new construction after an event can make the distance too short; this bias is shared by positives and controls and is stated, not corrected
source.retrieval: sha256 and retrieval time are written to data/v07/source.json before use

infrastructure.building: closed or open way with a 'building' tag (any value except 'no'); the distance uses the outline vertices; multipolygon relations are ignored
infrastructure.road: way with highway in [motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified, residential, living_street, service] and the *_link variants; footways, paths and forest tracks excluded; segments densified to <= 25 m vertices
infrastructure.distance_note: nearest-vertex distance, error <= about 13 m for roads and the building extent; values above the cap are set to the cap and flagged

variants.combined_infra: V0.5 combined + infra (same V0.5 interactions, none new)

a_in_model.cv: the frozen V0.5 plan (5x5, purged), unchanged; V0.5 hyperparameters; no tuning

b_equal_visibility.caliper: a control is kept iff 0.5 <= (1 + d_inf_control) / (1 + d_inf_positive) <= 2 with d_inf = dist_infrastructure_m
b_equal_visibility.scoring: the stored V0.5 out-of-fold scores of static, temporal, combined (no infrastructure features in these models) are re-ranked within the retained controls; groups with fewer retained controls are dropped and counted
b_equal_visibility.ablation: conditional logit combined without the five lc_* columns, same folds, evaluated on all groups and on caliper-restricted groups
b_equal_visibility.paired: restricted minus all groups for static and combined, conditional logit, same groups where both exist

metrics: V0.5 definitions; local AUC computed per group with k = number of retained controls (any fixed k per group); unit-weighted
diagnostics: share of capped values by class
Spearman correlation of dist_infrastructure_m with elevation and with the lc_* shares
number of groups kept by the caliper
interpretation_limits: OSM completeness varies and improves over time; remote sites may be mapped later than their neighbours; absence of nearby infrastructure is not absence of reports; no causal reading
